reviews.title: Bring back the old UI
reviews.text: The new update makes it so hard to see when you’ve completed habits in the monthly activity view. You removed the days and dates! And the calendar is sideways which does feel intuitive at all. There’s no more “time of day” groupings which makes these habits less impactful and less full to knock off milestones throughout the day. Also getting details isn’t intuitive at all. Previously you just clicked into it now you have to slide and select. Please reconsider this update

reviews.title: Please bring back to old  UX!
reviews.text:
I’ve been using your app for several years and I love it. I’m so disappointed by the new interface. What used to feel like a very calming natural UX feels very stiff and rigid now.  The red and black feels very intense and selecting and checking off habits in a row feels buggy and slow. 

I used to love how I could see the moods assigned to the days that have already been completed that week. Also, now when I assign moods to a journal entry, the entry options are so large, but it’s challenging to select multiple which I used to enjoy doing. I think what you’ve built is awesome and hope that some of the features from the old version come back!  As it is right now, I will most likely be switching to a different app.

reviews.title: Good, Not Great
reviews.text:
I like the concept, especially the mood journaling and the emotional element. However, the actual functionality of the app has become frustrating. Here are a few observations after using the app almost daily for several months:

- It crashes a lot (not every day, but multiple times a week)

- It’s frustrating to edit habits for past days (or past midnight for “today” if you’re a night owl like me) bc of the way it constantly skips to the current day without warning 

- I wish there was a way to update a habit (frequency, timing, etc.), but as it is rn, you have to archive the current habit and create a whole new one 

- The history function is basically useless…frustrating after subscribing to the paid version thinking there would be some kind of data or analytical component 

Again, great concept, but actual execution leaves a lot to be desired, especially for a paid subscription. I will be looking for a new solution.

reviews.title: Lots of potential in a broken app
reviews.text:
I love this app. It has helped me create some very good habits. Unfortunately the app messes up my streaks a lot. It will show on the calendar that I’ve completed a whole month of a habit but then it will say 3-day streak or something else inaccurate. Longest I’ve been able to have the app keep up was 28 days then it reset again. Even though I kept up with my habit and logged it every day! It will also send me notifications like 4 habits missed 1 habits skipped 0 habits completed when I have already completed most of my habits. Seemingly using random inaccurate data for their notifications is annoying.

This app has so much potential but it is broken in one of the most important ways! If I could get accurate streak numbers I would give it 5/5
